notices.short_title: Withdrawal of Proposed Amendments to MOMEs Press Credential Rules

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Subscription of 54 Postgres Enterprise DB Software Licenses
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration is holding a public comment period on a proposed purchase of 54 Postgres enterprise database software licenses, a notice published Jan. 21, 2026.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: 19 Mac Studio Computers, 19 Studio Displays, and AppleCare+ for 3 Years AR226141/ SO7642
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration is seeking public comment on a planned purchase of 19 Mac Studio computers, 19 Studio Displays and three-year AppleCare+ coverage.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Installation, Upgrades, Repair, Support, Maintenance and Professional Services of CCTV Equipment
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration is holding a public comment period on a proposed contract for installing, upgrading, repairing, supporting and maintaining closed-circuit television equipment, along with related professional services.

notices.short_title: Q094-124M- Tudor Park Adult Fitness Equipment Construction, Queens
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation will hold a public comment hearing on Jan. 28, 2026, on the proposed award of a contract for construction of adult fitness equipment at Tudor Park in Queens.

notices.short_title: Opportunities for a Better Tomorrow - Discretionary Contract
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services has posted a public comment notice on a discretionary contract with Opportunities for a Better Tomorrow, published Jan. 21, 2026.

notices.short_title: 84123P0015001 - Wayfinding Cartography, Map Artwork, and Printing Service
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation is holding a public comment period on a proposed contract for wayfinding cartography, map artwork, and printing services, with no dollar amount or vendor named in the notice.

notices.short_title: Brooklyn College - Cancer Center Chemistry Department Renovations RFB
notices.plain: City University is seeking bids for construction work on renovations to the chemistry department at Brooklyn College's Cancer Center, with responses due Feb. 9, 2026, and the contract going to the lowest qualified bidder.

notices.short_title: Generator Maintenance and Repair Requirement Contracts
notices.plain: City University seeks proposals from vendors for generator maintenance and repair requirement contracts, with responses due Feb. 17, 2026.

notices.short_title: Brooklyn College - Roosevelt Hall Renovation and HVAC Renovation
notices.plain: City University is seeking bids for a construction contract to renovate Roosevelt Hall and its HVAC system at Brooklyn College, with responses due Feb. 10, 2026.

notices.short_title: IFB 2200152 - Steel Crowd Control Barricades - NYPD - R1

notices.short_title: Consultant for Staffing Analysis at DOC
notices.plain: The Department of Correction awarded CLT Public Safety Consulting LLC an $800,000 contract for staffing analysis consulting, chosen through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: IT Consulting for IT Development & Management Project

notices.plain: NYC Health + Hospitals is seeking proposals from vendors for infrastructure assessment services, with responses due March 20, 2026, in a corrected solicitation for the Infrastructure Adoption Mode (INFRAM) Assessment Services.

notices.short_title: Roof Replacement
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority is seeking bids for a roof replacement project, with responses due Jan. 30, 2026, from a pre-qualified list of vendors, where the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: Photography and Videography for Events
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services awarded Sway NY LLC a $150,000 contract for photography and videography for events, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.
